title: Corner Chain Canonical Representation
description: Rectangular grid where some cells contain a positive integer clue. Shading cells splits the rest into white islands; a clue gives the size of its island. Even-sized islands are rectangles, odd-sized islands are not, and all islands link into one network through shared corners.

cells.description: m x n grid of integers. 0 = empty cell, any positive integer = the number of cells in the island containing this cell.
